hints.title: Frequency of Each Integer
hints.text: Count how many times each distinct integer appears in the array.

hints.title: Pairing and Leftovers
hints.text: Each number with count c yields c // 2 pairs and c % 2 leftover individual elements.

hints.title: Summing Across All Numbers
hints.text: Sum the pairs and leftover counts across all unique numbers.

hints.title: Frequency Counting Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def numberOfPairs(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        counts = Counter(nums)
        pairs = sum(c // 2 for c in counts.values())
        leftover = sum(c % 2 for c in counts.values())
        return [pairs, leftover]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterative deletion of pairs from the array takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counter hash map stores frequency per distinct number.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes pairs and remnants in O(n) using frequency counting.
